canonical: ASCII subset of RFC 8785 with exactly one terminal LF; all object key sequences below are literal and sorted. No whitespace, BOM, escapes or alternate spelling. Arrays maintain semantic order.

digest_domains.input_sha256: all actual B bytes including its sole final LF
digest_domains.source_manifest_sha256: all bytes of the externally fixed framed raw-source manifest, as defined below; actual research and scientific roots remain externally prebound

manifest.framing: prefix; u32be member count; by increasing unsigned ASCII relative path: u16be path length, path bytes, u16be role bitmask, u8 verifier-source flag, u64be raw size, raw contents; no trailing bytes; member paths unique and every role covered; this hash excludes C and its own root
manifest.paths: ASCII tokens [A-Za-z0-9._-]+ separated by slash; components . and .. and empty forbidden
manifest.verifier_source: sum raw sizes of all independently designated verifier source members <= 2 MiB; actual completeness and per-file flags/roles require external source custody

output_boundary: no production verified status accepted/emitted by synthetic judge; genuine independent verification report encoding is a separate deliverable; its byte budget applies to future outputs
paired_inputs: B original canonical count-table file incl one LF
C canonical outer report file incl one LF
status: unadopted representation proposal; current executable and approvals concern synthetic structural controls only

types.bindings: all five present in each coordinate; SHA-256 raw digest lower hex
types.endpoint: coefficient minimal signed decimal STRING (no plus, leading zero or -0); exponent minimal signed JSON integer; c=0 iff endpoint zero and e=0; nonzero coefficients odd. Zero exponent also valid for odd nonzero integers.
types.key: two-digit hex of each mask, plus-separated; mask list in ascending cardinality-then-lex registry
types.masks: JSON array of increasing integers 1..7, pairwise incomparable by bit inclusion, separate from and equal in meaning to key
types.product: reduced gcd-one pair of strictly positive minimal unsigned decimal strings
types.resources: all values exact nonnegative JSON integers, independently corroborated in the context of the specific producer and its own plan (independent implementation operation/heap counts may differ)
